description: Source code implementing Unicode string conversion utilities, including functions for reading and writing Unicode characters, and preparing output buffers for UTF-8 and UTF-16/32 encodings.

methods.name: ReadUnicodeCharacter
methods.description: Reads a Unicode character from a UTF-8 or UTF-16 source, updating the character index and outputting the code point.

methods.name: WriteUnicodeCharacter
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode code point into UTF-8 or UTF-16 and appends it to the output string.

methods.name: PrepareForUTF8Output
methods.description: Prepares a string buffer for UTF-8 output based on the input source.

methods.name: PrepareForUTF16Or32Output
methods.description: Prepares a string buffer for UTF-16 or UTF-32 output based on the input source.
